flats.desc: Seamless top-down floor of dark, worn tomb paving: big rectangular slate-grey and grey-green slabs in a loose running bond with thin dark joints, edges rounded by centuries of feet, a few slabs cracked. About one slab in six is a carved grave ledger: a slightly paler slab the size of a person (3 ft x 7 ft where it fits the tile, else half-length) with a shallow carved border and one simple emblem (ring-cross, sun-disc, shield, wreath), worn almost flat. NO letters or writing. Damp darkening and a little moss in some joints. Even, shadowless light; tiles on all four edges; reads as stone at table distance, not as a pattern of rectangles.

Seamless top-down floor of dark packed grave earth, grey-brown with paler dusty patches, strewn with old bones pressed half into the soil: scattered long bones, ribs, a few vertebrae, a jaw, and here and there a skull seen from above (about one skull per 5-ft tile, never in a regular pattern). Old ivory and tan bone, not white. Sparse enough that the earth is the main read and furniture can stand on it. Even, shadowless light; tiles on all four edges. No blood, no flesh.

Top-down decal on a transparent (keyed) background, about 3 ft x 2.5 ft: a small loose scatter of old bones lying on a floor with a soft contact shadow. Shape 1: a skull, two long bones and a few ribs. Shape 2: a broken ribcage and a pelvis. Shape 3: three long bones, a jaw and finger bones in a rough line. Old ivory and tan. Soft-edged, no ground painted.

Top-down opaque decal of one grave ledger stone set flush in a floor, 3 ft x 7 ft: a pale grey slab with a carved raised border and a worn emblem. Shape 1: a long-stemmed ring-cross and a small shield at the foot. Shape 2: a sun-disc over a sword laid down the middle. A thin dark joint line round the edge; NO letters. The flat twin of the tomb-slab mesh, for when a walkable marker is wanted.

Top-down soft-edged decal on a transparent background: an irregular patch of dark green moss and paler grey-green lichen with a damp darker halo, as it grows along the foot of a wet wall. Three shapes: a long strip for wall feet, a corner fan, a round blotch.

Top-down flat image of an altar cloth, 6 ft x 3 ft: cream linen with a broad burgundy and dull-gold embroidered border and one gold sun-disc in the middle; soft fold lines. Lies on altar-stone. No blue.
